docs.roles_responsibilities: Incident commander (on-call SRE lead), security lead (CISO), communications lead (Legal/PR), and forensics liaison are named with 24x7 contact details and defined authority
docs.detection_escalation: Alerts from the SIEM, WAF, and FIM page the on-call responder; SEV-1 (suspected cardholder data exposure) escalates to the incident commander and CISO within 15 minutes and to the acquirer and card brands per their timelines
docs.communication_plan: Internal notification via the incident bridge, customer status-page updates, and external notification of the acquirer, card brands, and regulators within contractually and legally required timeframes
